description: PLA search-query (what shoppers actually TYPED) performance for a marketplace over a period, from os_ads_search_query_performance_report: impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, and an AUTO-vs-manual match-type split of impressions and clicks. Grouped by search_query. Dates are bucketed in the agency's local timezone via the __SP_TIMEZONE__ system placeholder. Filter by search_query to scope to specific terms.

search_query.description: The search term the shopper typed that these ads served against.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions for this search query.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks for this search query.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this search query, in the currency stored on the search-query report (p.cost).

ctr.selector: COALESCE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END) * 100.0, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 0)
ctr.description: Click-through rate (%) = clicks / impressions * 100 for this search query.

auto_impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type = 'AUTO' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
auto_impressions.description: Impressions served via AUTO (auto-targeted) match type for this search query.

auto_clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type = 'AUTO' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
auto_clicks.description: Clicks on ads served via AUTO (auto-targeted) match type for this search query.

manual_impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type != 'AUTO' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
manual_impressions.description: Impressions served via non-AUTO (manual / broad / phrase / exact) match types for this search query.

manual_clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type != 'AUTO' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
manual_clicks.description: Clicks on ads served via non-AUTO (manual / broad / phrase / exact) match types for this search query.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_search_query_performance_report` AS p JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON p.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
